Positive single-well quadratic/quartic elastic energy and scalar kinetic energy oppose this. Adding a charge can reduce the preferred scalar amplitude by changing actual fermion occupation. Finite mean(phi)=0 is compatible with quantum bimodality; no branch/sign is chosen by hand.

Hamiltonian.holonomy: B_(a,t,m)=exp(-i theta S_a) d_(t,m)^dag exp(i theta S_a)-exp(i theta S_a) d_(t,m)^dag exp(-i theta S_a). F_a=(hop/2) sum_(t,m) eta_t d_(t,m)^dag B_(a,t,m)^dag with eta=(+1,-1). H0=sum_a(exp(i k_a)F_a+h.c.)+lambda sum S_a^2.

These are actual uniform Peierls-link phase derivatives, not Noether S or field-coordinate derivatives. The finite fixed-k cell is not a demonstrated propagating bulk current or EM field.
